description.value: Bridge Brewing is a North Vancouver craft brewery whose Charlotte Road tasting room pours core and seasonal house beers in a venue with outdoor seating. The operation spans multiple North Shore locations and includes an on-site 'Bridge Arcade' with interactive experiences such as Bridge Pong and Brewery Dash. Its position near North Shore cycling corridors makes it a natural social stop for touring cyclists.
